bundle.longDescription: AI Usage Meter lives in your menu bar (macOS) or system tray (Windows) and shows how much of your Claude, Codex and Grok subscription limits you have left, with live reset countdowns. It reuses the logins of the official Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build CLIs — no passwords, no cookies, no servers.
bundle.shortDescription: See how much Claude, Codex and Grok quota you have left — from your menu bar.
